finding_key: packages/docs/src/model/color.ts::new `isemptystoredcolor` dereferences an untrusted `storedcolor` without a type guard — a `null` color or an `{ kind: 'srgb', value: <non-string> }` persisted through the content put api throws a typeerror inside the paint path, crashing the renderer for every viewer of the document (stored dos).
evidence: Verified against the supplied packages/docs/src/model/color.ts:59-63: `isEmptyStoredColor` checks `c === undefined` (strict) then dereferences `c.kind` / calls `c.value.trim()`, so `null` or a non-string `value` throws a TypeError; previously `defaultColorResolver`'s `c == null` loose check handled null safely, so this is a regression introduced on every paint path (renderRun, renderListMarker, table-renderer, resolveColorAtPosition). The cited backend persistence path (slides PUT validation gaps, writeSlidesRoot verbatim assignment) could not be checked because those files were not supplied, so the full stored-DoS exploit chain is plausible but unverified — hence medium confidence. The defect in the code as written is real regardless: the guard is not total over the untrusted inputs the PR itself claims to defend against.
